Task: prompt-v1-fixture/duration-half-away-from-zero

`python3 tests/test_duration.py -v` fails: round_to_minutes does not round an
exact half minute away from zero. The contract is symmetric, so 30 seconds must
round to 1 minute and -30 seconds must round to -1 minute.

Editable files:
  src/duration.py

Make the validation command exit zero.
